test_title: SSC CGL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 6 March 2023)
subject: general
question:
‘A # B’ means ‘A is the brother of B’.

‘A @ B’ means ‘A is the daughter of B’.

‘A & B’ means ‘A is the husband of B’.

‘A % B’ means ‘A is the wife of B’.

If S % D # F @ G & H @ J,

then how is F related to J?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94f0af2bd93b93688d2c6092e652fb2d84f74342de195154154b4e73abc5a0da.png] 

Given :

 
 

 
 
A is

 
 
 

 
 
Symbol

 
 
 
#

 
 
 
@

 
 &
 %
 
 

 
 
Meaning

 
 
 
Brother

 
 
 
Daughter

 
 Husband
 Wife
 
 

 
 
to B

 
 
 

Given statement : S % D # F @ G & H @ J

So,

 
• S % D → S is the wife of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2ee4c9f4878c9413f458071ad44fc890cd708f9f797262963ab749a807712bf5.png] 

 
• D # F → D is the brother of F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/788dbf850729a66837260770b3c1f599f405676fbb66d24de6636e9cef4bfa3f.png] 

 
• F @ G → F is the daughter of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e377707644fc571ec61bbcd920c5f6113685cc9eeff08eed25e79e32e0fa1c8.png] 

 
• G & H → G is the husband of H.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2bf86326e831c5e788f45098b131954553aab06bbba329c25db3b95d2fea9c24.png] 

 
• H @ J → H is the daughter of J.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c839dfe8ea274cbdc70552068bf1ac40db1e042690b22bf78683b915147158b5.png] 

Thus, according to the final family tree F is the granddaughter i.e daughter's daughter of J.

Hence, **"Daughter’s daughter**" is the correct answer.
